status_legend.observed: read directly from the landmark track (image-plane geometry)
status_legend.inferred: derived with a stated assumption (monocular metric scale, static camera, 3D depth approximate)

stance_width_m.evidence: frames 30.4-34.8s (ch2 stance hold): median ankle lateral separation in the hip-line frame
stance_width_m.confidence: high for the ratio; metric value depends on monocular scale (assumed coach height 1.78 m)

stance_width_over_body_height.evidence: same window; separation / standing body height (scale-free)

stance_width_g1_equivalent_m.evidence: same window: ratio x G1 height 1.32 m (relationship-preserving; independent of the coach's true height)
stance_width_g1_equivalent_m.confidence: medium: uniform scaling, G1 leg proportions differ from a human's

stance_depth_m.evidence: same window: median front-to-back ankle separation (feet nearly level in the taught square stance)
stance_depth_m.confidence: medium: monocular depth is the least reliable axis

stance_depth_g1_equivalent_m.evidence: same window: ratio x G1 height

stance_torso_pitch_deg.evidence: same window: pelvis-to-head axis vs vertical

stance_pelvis_height_m.evidence: same window: pelvis above floor (world landmarks)

stance_head_above_pelvis_m.evidence: same window: nose above pelvis height

value.axes: [forward, left, up] metres relative to the pelvis

stance_hand_carriage_rel_pelvis.evidence: same window: wrist medians in the body frame

stance_widen_step_window.evidence: ch2 27.6-30.4s: stance widened 0.26 -> 0.67 m; the widening step moves the rear foot back-and-out
stance_widen_step_window.confidence: medium (single take; step direction from image metric)

level_change_pelvis_drop_g1_m.evidence: same: ratio x G1 height 1.32 m

level_change_duration_s.evidence: ch5 259.7-261.2s full down-and-up cycle; the drop itself occupies ~0.4-0.8 s

level_change_min_pelvis_h_m.evidence: same window: lowest pelvis height reached

shot_lead_foot_offset_m.evidence: ch7 430.5-433.0s (knee-on-mat hold): forward offset of the lead ankle from the pelvis (world-landmark body frame; depth axis approximate)
shot_lead_foot_offset_m.confidence: medium-low: monocular depth; direction (in front) is reliable, magnitude is not

shot_rear_foot_offset_m.evidence: same window: rear ankle offset (negative = behind the pelvis)

shot_entry_pelvis_h_start_end_m.evidence: ch7: pelvis height at the start of the entry vs during the knee-on-mat hold

shot_knee_min_height_m.evidence: ch7 422.8-431.0s: lowest knee landmark height above the floor (0.00 m = on the mat)
shot_knee_min_height_m.confidence: high for 'knee reaches the mat'; the exact contact instant is +-0.07 s

shot_knee_down_hold_s.evidence: ch7 430.5-433.0s: knee stays within 5 cm of the mat

shot_entry_duration_s.evidence: ch7 422.8-431.0s: crouched stance -> step -> penetration -> knee down
shot_entry_duration_s.confidence: medium (window chosen by content review of the trace)

shot_lead_foot_travel_imgplane_m.evidence: ch7 422.8-431.0s: lead ankle displacement in the image plane (UNDERESTIMATES the step when it travels toward the camera; the world-landmark offsets above are the usable entry depth)
shot_lead_foot_travel_imgplane_m.confidence: low for magnitude; the lead/trail assignment is reliable

shot_recovery_duration_s.evidence: ch7 432.5-437.0s: knee-off to standing crouched stance

shot_recovery_pelvis_h_end_m.evidence: same window: pelvis height at the end of the rise

knee_sprawl_drop_s.evidence: ch10 683.4-686.2s: standing to knee-on-mat (pelvis 0.68 -> 0.24 m in ~0.4 s)

knee_sprawl_knee_height_m.evidence: same window: knee landmark reaches the mat plane (negative = at/below the foot plane; landmark contact offset ~0.1 m, so treat 0.0 as 'on the mat')

knee_sprawl_pelvis_h_m.evidence: same window: lowest pelvis height at the drop (~0.30 m while sprawled)

knee_sprawl_hold_s.evidence: ch10 685.8-690.2s: knee stays near the mat while the torso is up

knee_sprawl_recover_s.evidence: ch10 779.8-782.2s: rise from the knee to a crouched stance (pelvis 0.04 -> 0.63 m)

stalk_cadence_events_per_s.evidence: ch3 122.0-131.6s: foot-repositioning events (ankle moves >0.10 m within 0.27 s), both feet
stalk_cadence_events_per_s.confidence: low-medium: monocular ankle height noise prevents separating steps from drags

stalk_step_length_m.evidence: ch3 122.0-131.6s: median event displacement, p10-p90 [0.122, 0.366] m

circle_step_length_m.evidence: ch4 178.0-190.0s: median event displacement, p10-p90 [0.116, 0.271] m

stance.why: highest mean landmark confidence (0.967), feet planted (0 foot-repositioning events), pelvis travel 0.07 m net

level_change.chosen: 256.2-261.4s take (deepest drop: pelvis 0.85 -> 0.48 m); windows 259.7-261.2 (full) and 256.9-258.0 (fast)
level_change.why: largest sustained pelvis drop of the chapter with clean tracking (conf 0.93)
alternates: 201.5-223.4s take (crouch 2.3 s, drop to 0.69 m - shallower)

shots.why: contains the knee-to-mat contact (knee min 0.0 m, 4.1 s near the mat) and a complete rise
shots.note: the entry starts inside the preceding quiet period (423-430 s) that the activity detector split off; selected by content review

knee_sprawl.chosen: 683.4-686.2s entry + 685.8-690.2s hold (in the 661.5-685.7s take) and 779.8-782.2s recovery
knee_sprawl.why: cleanest knee-to-mat contact (knee min 0.00 m) and a complete rise; the 691-703s stretch is excluded (landmark glitches: speeds 8-12 m/s)

stalking.why: second and longer of two takes (conf 0.969); the first 1.5 s is a walk-in and was excluded

circling.why: highest-confidence circling take without NaN frames

tie_breaker: operator two-axis rule when the video geometry is not statically holdable for the G1: (a) sagittal - rear leg further back; (b) frontal - widen the stance. Both preserve the wrestling read.

metric_scale.note: mediapipe's monocular metric scale reads the coach at ~1.52 m. If his true height is 1.78 m, multiply every raw metre value by ~1.17. Ratios and G1-equivalents are unaffected.
metric_scale.g1_equivalents: computed as ratio x G1 height (1.32 m), independent of the coach's true height

unknown.absolute_metric_scale: monocular; all metre values are inferred with coach height 1.78 m assumed; ratios are scale-free
unknown.depth_axis: front-to-back distances rely on mediapipe world-landmark depth (approximate); image-plane distances are reliable
unknown.contact_forces: no force information in video; mat contact inferred from landmark height only
unknown.knee_yaw_hip_rotation: rotation about the vertical axis is weakly observable from the monocular track
unknown.hand_grip_detail: finger-level detail is dropped (G1 has no fingers); hands are treated as wrist sites
unknown.lead_leg_identity_in_shot: which leg the coach leads with varies between repetitions; the spec reports the measured lead per window
